CTG is fully recovered from salary as free stay was provided

questions.explanation_english: It does not affect CTG; CTG is a lump-sum transfer grant Composite Transfer Grant is a lump-sum grant intended to cover indirect shifting expenses like packing, local cartage, and setting up a new household. questions.question_english:
Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R).
Assertion (A): Mileage allowance is generally not admissible when a government servant is provided with a free departmental vehicle for an official journey.
Reason (R): Travelling Allowance is compensatory in nature, and free conveyance eliminates the out-of-pocket transportation expense for the employee.
options_english: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A Travelling Allowance is an allowance designed purely to reimburse actual out-of-pocket expenses incurred during official travel. When government servants utilize free departmental transport, they incur no personal transportation costs. Hence, claiming mileage allowance is disallowed, as free conveyance eliminates the out- of-pocket expenditure, satisfying the underlying fundamental purpose of travel rules.

questions.question_english: Examine the following provisions regarding the reimbursement of food bills on tour under the 7th CPC TA Rules: I. Food bills up to the prescribed ceiling are reimbursed based on actuals II. Reimbursement can be claimed purely on self-certification without producing actual vouchers, subject to the ceiling III. I and III only

questions.explanation_english: I and II only Under 7th CPC rules, reimbursement of food expenses on tour is payable up to the prescribed ceiling based on actuals or self-certification without producing vouchers.
